people.name: Cush
people.line: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon

people.name: Mareshah
people.line: A town in Judah; fortified by Rehoboam

translations.web: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.
translations.bsb: Then Zerah the Cushite came against them with an army of 1,000,000 men and 300 chariots, and they advanced as far as Mareshah.
translations.kjv: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
translations.asv: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an army of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and he came unto Mareshah.
